connector.name: Contabo (VPS) MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Contabo API (v1.0.0) as MCP tools for cloud provisioning, and management. Powered by HAPI MCP server
connector.summary: Hosted at contabo.run.mcp.com.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.com.mcp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
